posts.cooked:
Just under two hours? Actually shorter than I was anticipating! This opening theme though, holy crap, that’s amazing. That whole intro, you can just hear Adam’s soul leaving his body in real time. “I’m Adam. Why must I be Adam?”

Sounds like Covid gave Adam the ability to gain energy from the cold by breathing it in.

No Princess Cool letter? Inconceivable! D: I have noticed a distinct lack of letters from her over the past couple years, though, I do hope she’s okay.

I always wondered why Mocktriarch’s HP was like that.

Oh boy, this is gonna be a great episode already. After the week I’ve had, I’ve really needed this.

Somehow, I don’t think “I have a creepy uncle” is a great line to hook two people up.

Setback having to be the emotionally mature one is cute somehow.

Oh heck, Parse and Mordin would work, wouldn’t they? c.c

Questions about the state of GTG’s business plans are definitely the last thing I expected in this episode!

I protest, Museumsplosion does not sound like a dumb name!

“I’m your dad now!” omg XD

What era of comics were they thinking of, I wonder? (re: characters kissing and then it never coming up again)

…I’m sorry, Orbo? What? Literally how? God, did she just run through Endlings one after another? Was “Hey, wanna try restarting your species?” her pickup line? Come on.

Well, this episode was everything I ever could have wanted and more.

posts.cooked: Oh my, I didn’t think I was going to be super into this one, but I suddenly find myself super invested in the Ryan Frost and Karen Gold relationship. (I wonder if one of the things they bond over is having names that suggest comic book puns; doubtless at least one supervillain plot involved threatening to dip her in a pot of molten gold unless AZ could rescue her in time.) I also got a kick out of contemplating the Legacy / Dawn thing - it’s obviously not happening in our timeline, but would make a great Disparation for versions of them which are only slightly different. And I absolutely love the idea of Expatriette trying to do cuckqueaning, since we all know she has no idea what a healthy relationship looks like, and very well might decide that making herself unhappy is the only form of satisfaction she’s somewhat comfortable with. Setback would probably be the one who thinks it’s a horrible idea, and my twisted little mind can come up with all SORTS of ways for his luck-curse to interfere with the scenario.

posts.cooked: Almost every character got mentioned this episode, but I’m pretty sure one was missed; throughout the whole show, I don’t think I caught one reference to the Visionary. She’s certainly not the most romantic character; while Dark Mind is still part of the equation, neither Visionary can afford to distract herself from the other one, so I’d imagine she’s functionally asexual for her entire previous life. But post OblivAeon, when she’s finally Unleashed, I could see her deciding to make up for lost time in a big way (distinguishing her from Drake, who would probably stay ace even if he weren’t busy being the Sorcerer Supreme). I kinda like the idea of her and Aeon Girl bonding over their respective status as living weapons who now have a chance to figure out what being human is all about; Visi has purely detached, academic knowledge of the topic, and AG has none at all, so the two of them would be like a couple of teenagers ignorantly fumbling through the minefield of love, having no idea what they’re doing but blissfully content in their ignorance. And anyone else who learned that two of the most powerful women on the planet are playing with emotional dynamite would be rightly worried about the potential for catastrophe, but against all odds, these two blind-leading-the-blind partners would somehow manage to make it work.
